content: Home care platform feature set (Alora, BridgeCare, Carecenta, Viv, LEMR). Core: scheduling/rostering with conflict detection; caregiver credential & license tracking with expiry alerts; client/patient profiles + care plans; visit scheduling & recurring visits; open-shift broadcast/auto-fill; notifications (SMS/push/email); billing/invoices/payments; family portal; mobile caregiver app; admin dashboard + reports; ratings/reviews. US-specific EVV/Medicaid/ANSIX12/HIPAA features do not map to Pakistan.
